meta.title: Day 3 of 5: Mid Zones Close, Last Call at the Break Room
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day 3 of 5: the mid zones (Z5, Z7, Z8) close and take Bruiser's key with them; the terminal key is on its last day. Three routes, three encounters, key availability, early-descent handling, last-chance hooks and a stall fallback. CR, budget, credit and loot figures are cited from rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json by field path (GM-adaptable guideline). Collapse notices use Lore's draft wording; the final collapse is fixed and a missed collapse is death on every floor, with no Reprieve.

clock.zone_groups: Confirmed (decision 026, tagged inspired): outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close Day 2; mid zones (Z5, Z7 and Z8) close Day 3; on Day 4 the Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; on Day 5 only the corridor (Z10, Z11 and Z S) remains. The Z9 Green Room saferoom stays open to the end (inspired). Closed means hooks and services vanish; the route (Z6, Z8, Z9, Z10, Z11) is never cut.
clock.stairwell_opens: About 32 hours after the floor opens, early Day 2 (canon M-276, VERIFIED). The Z10 boss arena also holds a stairwell (canon M-275). The Stairwell key and the Zone S door are house ideas, tagged inspired.
clock.early_descent: A Crawler who descends with more than 6 hours left on the floor is held in stasis until the floor collapses (canon M-277, VERIFIED): this banks the achievement and ends that Crawler's floor. In the last 6 hours, descent is free. Each Crawler chooses for themselves; the GM may override with a logged reason.
clock.collapse_order_status: confirmed per decision 026; the steps only remove hooks and services, and the Detour Tax is the only toll on the clock (a missed Stairwell key only)

final_collapse.status: Syndicate default, decision 026; Caleb may veto
final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day 5 (hour 120 of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.tag: canon-aligned (canon: a missed collapse ends the run)
collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death and revival follow Core Book Ch1, Death and Revival: death is permanent, Costly Revives are the default (rare and expensive), and a Replacement Crawler is the usual outcome. Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.
collapse_miss.stasis_counts: Early-descent stasis (canon M-277) counts as reaching a stairwell.
collapse_miss.detour_tax_scope: The Detour Tax now covers only a missed Stairwell key, never a missed collapse.

saferoom_rule.text: The Break Room (Z6) is a saferoom through Day 3 and stops being one when it loses service on Day 4 (Syndicate ruling, decision 026). From then on the Z9 Green Room is the only saferoom, open to the end of the floor (tagged inspired).

clock.achievement_caps: Floor caps still apply: the soft cap is 2 to 3 achievement boxes per Crawler per floor (Caleb's ruling), and Floors 1 and 2 keep the Silver ceiling. Story Boxes are separate: at most one per floor on Floors 1 and 2, outside the box caps and the budget. Rewards are tailored by the GM and snark-only is allowed; the proposed achievements are a seed list at GM discretion.

rest_fee_note.text: GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

Honest saferoom through Day 3; it stops being a saferoom when it loses service on Day 4 (decision 026).

A field rest can only be a Short Rest (Core Book Ch1, The Floor Clock and Saferooms: Long Rests only in saferooms). The rest-without-a-saferoom price (rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json#floors.1.prices.rest_without_saferoom) buys a quiet Short Rest and grants no Long Rest; unpaid or noisy, Ceiling Ticks interrupt it (00-overview.md section 2 rule 7). A saferoom is where the day's Long Rest happens (the Break Room through Day 3, the Green Room always). GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

day.stall_fallback: If the party stalls, the System posts the next-collapse countdown (Break Room and vendors lose service tomorrow), the Lights-Out hour arrives, and the day rolls over at 24 in-game hours. A party that has not bought the key still has the Mystery Key (if drawn), tools, force, or the toll at the door. A Crawler who is not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, with no Reprieve (decision 026); keep the warning in view.

quick_run.setup: The Break Room is on its last day of service and CLOSING SOON is taped to the fridge.
quick_run.decision: Buy the terminal key and supplies now, or gamble on the other key routes?
quick_run.on_success: The party leaves stocked and with a key way settled.
quick_run.on_failure: They leave empty-handed and must use the Detour Tax, tools or force at the door.
quick_run.cut_short: Skip the receipts and the corkboard; take only the key and the supplies.

changes.choice: Buy the terminal key before it vanishes
changes.effect: Buying today means a quiet Zone S entry with no toll at the Day 5 turnstile. Skipping it leaves the Mystery Key, tools, force or the Detour Tax.
Vendor stock is shared floor-wide and disappears on Day 4; what the party buys now is all they will have for the Dean.
The terminal's loophole line is read and the Read the Fine Print nod may be awarded; the Zone S route skips the Dean and forfeits the Boss Box.

win.text: Hall cleared, shutters stopped. The zone behind you is gone for good. Keep moving.

gm_color.text: The hall is closing and so is your window. Rats and worse are leaving the zones that were turned off, and they're all headed your way.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If the party tries to loot the closed zone, the shutters seal over it and the System posts a 'closed' toast; the cost is a lost round and a spent short-rest slot. If they stall in the hall, the Lights-Out hour arrives and Ceiling Ticks follow. Never a wipe.

proposed_achievements.name: Last One Out
proposed_achievements.trigger: Hold a closing zone until the party is clear, then reach the Green Room.
proposed_achievements.tag: proposed by Encounter Bot, framed by Lore, reward = slot for Syndicate
proposed_achievements.narration: Someone had to be the last one out, and it turned out to be you.

lines.text: The walls start shedding old posters and warning signs. Under them is raw stone with tally marks scratched by earlier Crawlers. Some tallies stop mid-row.
A hallway you crossed this morning is now a gap with a clean edge. You can still see the doorway on the far side, which is its own kind of insult.
Emergency lights flip from white to a tired orange. The recorded voice uses the same cheerful volume as everything else. Underpromise, over-demolish.
A crowd of mobs has stopped to watch the floor fall. They look as unhappy about it as you do.

quick_run.setup: A hall of sealed lockers with one clear path to the Green Room, and vermin fleeing the closing zones.
quick_run.decision: Fight through the displaced vermin, or hold the hall so everyone gets clear?
quick_run.on_success: The party reaches the Green Room and the zone behind them is gone.
quick_run.on_failure: The shutters seal and a Crawler is cut off, paying a lost round and a short-rest slot.
quick_run.cut_short: Run one combat round and one hazard check; skip the second mob group.

flavor: Dale's HVAC License: Advantage on duct and vent checks.
Tanya's Note: one use. Name the true trigger or tell of one Floor 1 hazard in this encounter. The GM picks which hazard.

changes.choice: Fight through or hold the hall
changes.effect: A cleared hall costs a wandering encounter from the cap of two. A Crawler who holds the hall until the party is clear may earn the Last One Out nod.

changes.choice: Try to loot the closed zone
changes.effect: The shutters seal over it and the System posts a closed toast; the loss is permanent, including Bruiser's key if it was never taken.
The condition the party carries into the Green Room sets whether they need the night's Short Rests on Day 4.
